# MediaPipe Tasks Vision (vendored)

Files in this folder come from the npm package `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.0.1`
and the `pose_landmarker_lite` model published by Google, both licensed under
the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

They are bundled so the AI form coach works fully offline and on-device.
